gaps.sentence: The rescuers worked ___ the night to reach the trapped family.
gaps.explanation: 'Work through the night' = continue working for the whole night.

gaps.sentence: The bridge is ___ repair, so traffic uses the bypass.
The findings will be published in ___ course.
gaps.hint: in ___ course = at the right time
gaps.explanation: 'In due course' = eventually, when the time is right.

gaps.sentence: It is about time the board ___ a decision about the site, one way or the other.
gaps.explanation: 'It is about time + subject + past simple' expresses the unreal past.

gaps.sentence: You'd better hurry, ___ you'll miss the flight.
gaps.explanation: 'Otherwise' = if you do not, then this will happen.
Past perfect for the earlier of two past moments.

gaps.sentence: The first edition of the book ___ out in 1998.
She's the most generous person I've ___ met.
gaps.explanation: 'the best… I've ever seen/met' — 'ever' with superlatives.
